existing_integer_model: CssIntegerRounding rounds rational values to a unit integer with half-up interval/floor laws; it does not model directed round(A,B), truncating remainder or a general step. Reuse Rat/Int library laws rather than duplicate its unit-rounding theorem.
existing_calculation_model: CssMathExpression/Calculation supports arithmetic, calc, min/max/clamp; no Round constructor or remainder-to-adjacent-bound contract found. FiniteScalar models rational arithmetic/signed zero, not this branch.
scope: Bounded audit of locally authored canonical numeric/math modules and named round/remainder declarations. No canonical edits or additional registration credit.
